quest.title: The Littlest Journey: Means of Self-Defense?
quest.description: Little Meng is making preparations for his trip...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? These two ores aren't the same either?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Of course not. The quality and price of anything forged from either of these types of ores would be completely different.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Um, but... But this is all we have left of these two types, right?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hi there, Traveler! I'm currently helping Dad check on the ironware that he's ordered.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Mister Blacksmith over here is totally the best! He said he'd forge me a small sword, too!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But he says that there haven't been enough raw materials to go around the store lately, so Dad's batch of ironware might be delayed...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: And I've got no idea when my sword will be ready, either...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, it can't be helped. We've been very busy lately, so we're more or less out of ore.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: The areas where ore is most plentiful are also occupied by many monsters, so I dare not go mining there...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: I can only try to tide this busy period over before asking an adventurer to escort me to an area where I can mine.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But when will that be...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Actually, Traveler, I've heard that you're really good at beating monsters. Is that true?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: If it is, could you please help me out? Please...

response.speaker: Master Zhang
response.text: Traveler, are you going to check the situation out there? In that case, let me mark my usual mining spots on the map for you...

response.speaker: Master Zhang
response.text: Alright, that should do it. Be careful while you're there. Those places are crawling with monsters.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: I'm counting on you then, Traveler!

choices.text: I'll... see what I can do.

talks.objective: Go to where the monsters have gathered and defeat them

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: How are things going there, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They should be safe for now.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Wow, you're amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Dad said that he will hire a few people to protect us while we're traveling.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I just hope those people are as good as you are, Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Mister Blacksmith, does this mean that you can continue mining and making the ironware now?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Hahaha, of course! Just give me a moment to prepare. I'll get those ores and be back in time to continue my work!

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: That said, there is a limit to how much ore I can carry by myself. With any luck, that area should be free of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you then, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Be careful out there. Those mining spots are teeming with monsters.
